H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H4279: properly, deferred, i.e. the morrow; usually (adverbially) tomorrow; indefinitely, hereafter
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H2114: to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be aforeigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery

H3515: heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid)
H2534: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)

H160: {affection (in a good or a bad sense)}

H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)

H7649: satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense)
H5317: a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H4751: bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly

H6098: advice; by implication, plan; also prudence

H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)

H7350: remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)
H2449: to be wise (in mind, word or act)

H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again

H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H6064: properly, to urge; by implication, to inflict apenalty, specifically, to fine
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H899: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage

H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute

H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)

H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H1270: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
H2300: to be (causatively, make) sharp or (figuratively) severe
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H3513: to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H7646: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H3564: a pot or furnace (as if excavated)
H2091: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H4388: a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth)
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5145: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling

H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3532: a ram (just old enough to butt)
H3830: a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife
H6260: prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people
H1767: enough (as noun or adverb), used chiefly with preposition in phrases
H5795: a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
